BUILDING INSPECTION REPORT
Building: Government Office Complex, New Delhi
1. Executive Summary
This report documents structural defects observed during the annual inspection.
2. Defects Observed
Spalling was observed on ground floor RCC columns due to corrosion of reinforcement.
Honeycombing detected in beam B-4 at second floor level.
Water seepage noted in basement slab caused by poor waterproofing.
Efflorescence visible on exterior masonry walls indicating water ingress.
3. Repair Recommendations
Apply concrete jacketing to corroded columns as per CPWD Handbook Section 4.3.
Carry out epoxy injection for honeycombing repair per IS 456.
Apply waterproofing membrane to basement slab per CPWD Maintenance Manual.
